arguments.summary: Ported FeeRule, FlatFee and PercentFee to C++, a hierarchy C# classes derive from: each C# subclass's object runs on a director of the class it derives from, whose virtual members call the C# object's overrides, with a base export per virtual member for C#'s base calls (D-87); the C# classes are façades.
review_notes: A ported constructor calls no virtual member, so every C# subclass runs on a director; the protected members stay protected, the bridge reaching them through the director.
